title: Seismology
description: Earthquakes send two kinds of wave through rock: fast pressure waves and slower shear waves. Time the gap between them and you know how far away the source is; time it at three stations and you know where. Unlocks the Seismograph.

puzzle.goal: An earthquake sends compressional waves through rock at speed v _ p and slower shear waves at v _ s. A seismometer records the second kind arriving a time T after the first. Write how far away, L, the quake happened.
puzzle.name: Hypocentre from two arrivals
puzzle.form: T * v _ p * v _ s / ( v _ p - v _ s )
puzzle.ask: Find L in kilometres for a 2 second gap, with P = 6.0 km/s and S = @{S} km/s.
puzzle.method: The slow wave takes d/v_s, the fast one d/v_p; their difference is Δt. Solve for d.
